# SN Enviro Attendance Portal

> High-performance enterprise attendance and field operations management system for SN Enviro.

## Primary Routes
- [Employee Dashboard](https://attendance.snenviro.org/dashboard): Mark attendance, real-time telemetry, session status.
- [Leave & WFH Hub](https://attendance.snenviro.org/dashboard): Apply for casual/sick leave and track quotas.
- [Official Website](https://attendance.snenviro.org/): Portal homepage and organizational information.
